name: PM01

source.quote: EngineAI releases PM01 humanoid robot for commercial, educational use
can operate for two hours on a single charge
unified price of 88,000 yuan ($12,000 U.S.) until March 31, 2025

timeline.detail: Launched as an open-source, general-purpose humanoid at 88,000 yuan ($12,000), positioned $3,000 below Unitree's G1.

source.quote: This positions the PM01 $3,000 below Unitree's G1 humanoid.

timeline.detail: EngineAI released video of a PM01 performing what it called the world's first humanoid front flip.

source.quote: A Chinese humanoid robot lands the world's first front flip

notes: The front-flip video (2025-02-23) is manufacturer-produced marketing footage; it is recorded here under 'demonstrated' because the maneuver is a specific, visibly performed physical feat rather than a spec claim, but no independent (non-EngineAI) uncut footage was located during this build to confirm it as an unedited take.

EngineAI's own site (en.engineai.com.cn) only lists height, DOF and peak torque density; weight, battery runtime, walking speed and price were sourced from The Robot Report's 2024-12-27 launch coverage instead.
No named-customer shipment evidence (invoice, serial number, unboxing, customs record) was found during this build; delivery.status therefore stays 'demonstrated' rather than 'shipped'.

Shipped-bar research (2026-09-20): EngineAI's own claim is ~100 units delivered in five months including "Shenzhen police patrol support", which would be a strong named-customer claim if independently verified -- but this pass found no independent photo/video of a PM01 physically in Shenzhen police possession, nor any consumer unboxing video with a named buyer. Not upgraded to shipped.
